description: This file defines a UsersController class for handling user-related HTTP requests such as user creation and login, utilizing ASP.NET Core MVC framework and MediatR for command dispatching.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class managing user creation and login API endpoints, delegating logic to MediatR commands.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create new users, dispatching Create.Command via mediator.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests for user login, dispatching Login.Command via mediator.
